{{nowrap|[[YouTube]] {{small|([https://www.youtube.com/@HollywoodCreativeAlliance @HollywoodCreativeAlliance])}}}} | website = [http://theastras.com theastras.com] }} '''The Astra Awards''' (formerly known as the '''Los Angeles Online Film Critics Society Awards''' and the '''Hollywood Critics Association Awards''') is an annual awards ceremony hosted by the [[Hollywood Creative Alliance]] to recognize achievements in the entertainment industry. These awards span categories in film, television, and digital media, honoring technical and creative excellence. {{TOC limit}} ==History== On January 10, 2018, the group held its first annual Film Awards at the Taglyan Complex in Los Angeles.{{cite web |last=Rizzo |first=Carita |date=2018-01-11 |title='Shape of Water,' 'Lady Bird' Win Top Honors at L.A. Online Film Critics Society Awards |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/los-angeles-online-film-critics-society-awards-winners-list-1074109/ |access-date=2022-10-13 |website=The Hollywood Reporter}} On August 29, 2021, the HCA held its inaugural [[1st Hollywood Critics Association TV Awards|Hollywood Critics Association TV Awards]]. The event was originally to take place in-person but was shifted to virtual due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |last=Schneider |first=Michael |date=2021-08-17 |title=Hollywood Critics Association Cancels Sunday's In-Person TV Awards, Shifts to Virtual on Aug. 29 (EXCLUSIVE) |url=https://variety.com/2021/tv/news/hollywood-critics-association-tv-awards-covid-virtual-1235043209/ |access-date=2022-10-13 |website=Variety}} Ashley Menzel said, "Over these past 14 months, many of us have been watching more television than ever before. This is why we are absolutely delighted that our first in-person event for 2021 will begin with a brand-new event paying tribute to the best of television".{{cite web |title=Hollywood Critics Association Announces Dates for TV Awards & Film Awards – Hollywood Critics Association |url=https://hollywoodcriticsassociation.com/hollywood-critics-association-announces-dates-for-tv-awards-film-awards/ |access-date=2021-07-12}} On February 28, 2022, the [[5th Hollywood Critics Association Film Awards|5th HCA Film Awards]] took place at the [[Avalon Hollywood]]. [[Apple TV+]]'s ''[[CODA (2021 film)|CODA]]'' won Best Picture, Best Adapted Screenplay, and Best Supporting Actor for [[Troy Kotsur]]. [[Kristen Stewart]] won Best Actress for ''[[Spencer (film)|Spencer]]'' and [[Andrew Garfield]] won Best Actor for ''[[Tick, Tick... Boom! (film)|Tick, Tick... Boom!]]''.{{cite web |last=Urban |first=Sasha |date=2022-03-01 |title=Hollywood Critics Association Awards 2022: 'CODA' Wins Best Picture, Jane Campion and Denis Villeneuve Tie for Director |url=https://variety.com/2022/awards/news/hollywood-critics-association-awards-winners-2022-coda-jane-campion-denis-villeneuve-1235192239/ |access-date=2022-10-13 |website=Variety}} On August 13 and 14, 2022, the HCA hosted their [[2nd Hollywood Critics Association TV Awards|2nd Annual HCA TV Awards]] at the [[The Beverly Hilton|Beverly Hilton]]. The two-night event dedicated one night to broadcast and cable networks and the other to streaming platforms. [[Dulcé Sloan]] hosted night one while [[Cameron Esposito]] hosted night two.{{cite web |last=Tinoco |first=Armando |date=2022-08-15 |title=HCA TV Awards: 'Severance' Tops Streaming Winners In Night 2, Joining 'The White Lotus', 'Abbott Elementary', 'Better Call Saul' |url=https://deadline.com/2022/08/hca-tv-awards-winners-list-1235091768/ |access-date=2022-10-13 |website=Deadline}} On October 13, 2022, HCA President Nikki Fowler announced the Inaugural [[1st Hollywood Critics Association Creative Arts Film Awards|Creative Arts Awards]], "dedicated to celebrating those behind the scenes who don't often get the level of recognition they deserve."{{cite web |title=Hollywood Critics Association Announces Inaugural Creative Arts & 6th Annual Film Awards Dates – Hollywood Critics Association |url=https://hollywoodcriticsassociation.com/hollywood-critics-association-announces-inaugural-creative-arts-6th-annual-film-awards-dates/ |access-date=2022-10-13}} On December 15, 2022, ''[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]'' shared the list of nominations for the [[6th Hollywood Critics Association Film Awards|6th HCA Film Awards]] and the inaugural HCA Creative Arts Awards, with [[A24]]'s ''[[Everything Everywhere All at Once]]'' garnering a leading 16 nominations.{{cite web |last=Davis |first=Clayton |date=2022-12-15 |title=A24's 'Everything Everywhere All at Once' Leads HCA Film Awards Total Nominations With 16 |url=https://variety.com/2022/awards/awards/hca-film-awards-nominations-2023-1235462321/ |access-date=2023-03-08 |website=Variety}} On February 16, 2023, The HCA announced a new partnership with KNEKT Television Network where the Film Awards would be live-streamed on their network in addition to the official HCA app and [[YouTube]] channel.{{Cite web |date=2023-02-16 |title=The Hollywood Critics Association Announces Additional Honorees, Presenters, and Partnership with Knekt Television Network for the 2023 Awards |url=https://www.awardsdaily.com/2023/02/16/the-hollywood-critics-association-announces-additional-honorees-presenters-and-partnership-with-knekt-television-network-for-the-2023-awards/ |access-date=2023-03-08 |website=Awards Daily}} On February 24, 2023, the 6th HCA Film Awards took place at the [[Beverly Wilshire Hotel]]. ''Everything Everywhere All At Once'' took home a total of six awards.{{Cite web |date=2023-02-25 |title=HCA Film Awards 2023 Winners: Everything Everywhere All at Once Wins Six Trophies, SS Rajamouli's RRR Bags Four; Brendan Fraser, Michelle Yeoh Score Best Actor Awards – See Full List |url=https://www.latestly.com/socially/entertainment/hollywood/hca-film-awards-2023-winners-everything-everywhere-all-at-once-wins-six-trophies-ss-rajamoulis-rrr-bags-four-brendan-fraser-michelle-yeoh-score-best-actor-awards-at-see-full-li-4883080.html |access-date=2023-03-08 |website=LatestLY}} On June 27, 2023, ''[[Awards Daily]]'' revealed the 2023 HCA Midseason Movie Awards nominees.{{cite web |date=June 28, 2023 |title=Hollywood Critics Association Announces Nominees for 2023 HCA Midseason Movie Awards |url=https://www.awardsdaily.com/2023/06/27/hollywood-critics-association-announces-nominees-for-2023-hca-midseason-movie-awards/ |access-date=2023-07-05}} [[Amazon MGM Studios|Amazon Studios]]' ''[[Air (2023 American film)|Air]]'' and A24's ''[[Past Lives (film)|Past Lives]]'' tied for the most nominations with seven each. On June 30, 2023, ''[[Gold Derby]]'' revealed the 2023 HCA Midseason Movie Awards winners.{{cite web |date=June 28, 2023 |title=2023 HCA Midseason Awards: 'Across the Spider-Verse' wins Best Picture; 'Barbie' tops 'Oppenheimer' as most anticipated release [FULL WINNERS LIST] |url=https://www.goldderby.com/article/2023/2023-hca-midseason-awards-full-winners-list/ |access-date=2023-07-05}} ''[[Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse]]'' was awarded Best Picture and Best Director. ''Past Lives'' won the most awards with three wins, including Best Actress for [[Greta Lee]], Best Screenplay for [[Celine Song]], and Best Indie Film. In December 2023, the Hollywood Critics Association was renamed the Hollywood Creative Alliance, and its awards were rebranded as the Astra Awards.{{cite web |last=Schneider |first=Michael |date=December 1, 2023 |title=HCA Awards Rebrands as 'The Astra Awards'; Jeffrey Wright, Abby Ryder Fortson, Glenn Howerton to Receive Honors (EXCLUSIVE) |url=https://variety.com/2023/awards/news/hca-awards-astra-awards-jeffrey-wright-abby-ryder-fortson-glenn-howerton-1235816597/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231203213618/https://variety.com/2023/awards/news/hca-awards-astra-awards-jeffrey-wright-abby-ryder-fortson-glenn-howerton-1235816597/ |archive-date=December 3, 2023 |access-date=December 8, 2023 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}} This change, approved by the advisory committee on November 17, 2023, led to the renaming of the HCA Film Awards, HCA TV Awards, and HCA Creative Arts Awards to the Astra Film Awards, the Astra TV Awards, and the Astra Creative Arts Awards, respectively.{{cite web |last=Schneider |first=Michael |date=August 27, 2023 |title=Hollywood Critics Association Reveals New Name, Restructuring Following Controversies (Exclusive) |url=https://variety.com/2023/tv/news/hollywood-critics-association-new-name-restructuring-creative-alliance-1235705431/ |access-date=December 8, 2023 |work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}}{{cite web |date=December 2023 |title=Hollywood Creative Alliance (HCA) Renames Award Shows to 'The Astra Awards'; Glenn Howerton, Abby Ryder Fortson, Jeffrey Wright to be Honored |url=https://awardswatch.com/hollywood-creative-alliance-hca-renames-award-shows-to-the-astra-awards-glenn-howerton-abby-ryder-fortson-jeffrey-wright-to-be-honored/ |website=awardswatch.com}} The [[7th Astra Film Awards]] took place on January 6, 2024, at the [[The Biltmore Los Angeles|Biltmore Hotel]] in Los Angeles,{{cite web |last1=Zeller |first1=Terry |date=1 December 2023 |title=HCA Awards Rebrands as 'The Astra Awards'; Jeffrey Wright, Abby Ryder Fortson, Glenn Howerton to Receive Honors (EXCLUSIVE) |url=https://nz.news.yahoo.com/hca-awards-rebrands-astra-awards-180530700.html |website=Yahoo News |language=en-NZ}} as the first ceremony to be held under the new name. It was produced by Content.23 Media, DIGA Studios, and Vox Productions. Nominations were announced live on the official HCA [[YouTube]] channel on December 7, 2023. That same day, the Astra Film Creative Arts Awards winners were announced, with the ceremony scheduled to take place on February 26, 2024, at City Market Social House in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]].{{cite magazine |last1=Grein |first1=Paul |date=19 December 2023 |title='Barbie,' Taylor Swift's 'Eras Tour' Film Nominated for The Hollywood Creative Alliance's 2024 Astra Awards |url=https://www.billboard.com/music/awards/2024-astra-awards-nominations-barbie-oppenheimer-1235546044/ |magazine=Billboard}}{{cite web |title=Hollywood Creative Alliance's Astra Awards |url=https://barcelona.splashmags.com/index.php/2024/01/hollywood-creative-alliances-astra-awards/#gsc.tab=0 |website=Splash Magazine}} ''Barbie'' led in the film categories winning eight awards, including Best Picture.{{Cite web |last=Feinberg |first=Scott |date=2024-01-07 |title=Astra Film Awards: 'Barbie' Wins Eight Awards, Including Best Picture |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/astra-film-awards-2024-winners-barbie-color-purple-american-fiction-1235781072/ |access-date=2024-08-06 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US}} On July 3, 2024, the winners of the Astra Midseason Awards were revealed via the HCA's social media channels. ''[[Dune: Part Two]]'' won Best Picture and Best Director, [[Zendaya]] won Best Actress for her performance in ''[[Challengers (film)|Challengers]]'', and [[Glen Powell]] won Best Actor for ''[[Hit Man (2023 film)|Hit Man]]''.{{Cite web |last=Neglia |first=Matt |date=2024-07-03 |title=The 2024 Hollywood Creative Alliance (HCA) Midseason Astra Award Winners |url=https://nextbestpicture.com/the-2024-hollywood-creative-alliance-hca-midseason-astra-award-winners/ |access-date=2024-08-06 |website=Next Best Picture |language=en-US}} The nominations for the 2024 Astra TV Awards were revealed on July 9, 2024. FX's ''[[The Bear (TV series)|The Bear]]'' topped the field with 15 bids followed by [[Max (streaming service)|Max]]'s ''[[Hacks (TV series)|Hacks]]'' and Hulu's ''[[Only Murders in the Building]]'' with 13 apiece for the Astra TV Awards.{{Cite web |last=Richmond |first=Ray |date=2024-07-10 |title=2024 Astra TV Awards: 'The Bear,' 'Hacks,' 'Only Murders in the Building,' 'Abbott Elementary,' 'Ghosts' top the nominations |url=https://www.goldderby.com/article/2024/2024-astra-tv-awards-bear-hacks-only-murders-in-the-building-nominations/ |access-date=2024-08-06 |website=GoldDerby |language=en-US}} The ceremony was held at the [[Avalon Hollywood]] on August 18, 2024.{{Cite web |date=2024-07-09 |title=AwardsWatch - HCA Astra TV Awards Nominations: 'The Bear,' 'Hacks,' 'The Morning Show,' 'Baby Reindeer' Lead Nominations |url=https://awardswatch.com/hca-astra-tv-awards-nominations-the-bear-hacks-the-morning-show-baby-reindeer-lead-nominations/ |access-date=2024-08-06 |website=AwardsWatch |language=en-US}} On November 25, 2024, the HCA revealed the nominees for their upcoming Creative Arts and Film Awards.{{Cite web |last=Davidson |first=Denton |date=2024-11-25 |title=‘Wicked’ dominates Astra Film and Creative Arts Awards with record-breaking 20 nominations |url=https://www.goldderby.com/article/2024/2024-astra-film-awards-nominations/ |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=GoldDerby |language=en-US}} ''[[Wicked (2024 film)|Wicked]]'' received the most nominations with 20, followed by ''[[Dune: Part Two]]'' with 16. The HCA announced that actor, comedian, and writer Peter Kim would host the Creative Arts Awards, while two-time Emmy Award winner [[Loni Love]] would host the Film Awards. On December 8, 2024, the HCA would host a two ceremony event taking place at the Taglyan Complex in Los Angeles. Winners included ''[[Wicked (2024 film)|Wicked]]'' for Best Picture, [[Timothée Chalamet]] for Best Actor in ''[[A Complete Unknown]]'', [[Cynthia Erivo]] for Best Actress in ''[[Wicked (2024 film)|Wicked]]'', [[Kieran Culkin]] for Best Supporting Actor in ''[[A Real Pain]]'', and a Best Supporting Actress tie between [[Ariana Grande]] in ''Wicked'' and [[Zoe Saldaña|Zoe Saldana]] in ''[[Emilia Pérez]]''.{{Cite web |last=Solzman |first=Danielle |date=2024-12-10 |title=The Astra Film and TV Awards Winners |url=https://awardsfocus.com/awards/the-astra-film-and-tv-awards-winners/ |access-date=2025-01-24 |website=Awards Focus |language=en-US}} On February 20, 2026, the HCA announced the creation of the Astra Book Awards. The inaugural awards ceremony took place on April 20, 2026.{{Cite web |date=February 20, 2026 |title=The Hollywood Creative Alliance Launches Inaugural Astra Book Awards |url=https://theastras.com/the-hollywood-creative-alliance-launches-inaugural-astra-book-awards/ |access-date=2026-04-21 |website=TheAstras.com |language=en-US}} == Award ceremonies == ===Film Awards=== {| class="wikitable" |+ ! rowspan="2" |# ! rowspan="2" |Name of Ceremony ! rowspan="2" |Eligibility ! rowspan="2" |Date ! colspan="2" |Best Picture ! rowspan="2" |Host(s) ! rowspan="2" |Venue ! rowspan="2" |{{Abbr|Ref.|Reference(s)}} |- !Comedy or Musical !Drama |- |1st | rowspan="2" |Los Angeles Online Film Critics Society Awards |[[2017 in film]] |Wednesday, January 10, 2018 | colspan="2" |''[[The Shape of Water]]'' |{{unknown}} |Taglyan Complex, [[Los Angeles]] | |- |2nd |[[2018 in film]] |Wednesday, January 9, 2019 | colspan="2" |''[[The Hate U Give (film)|The Hate U Give]]'' |{{unknown}} |Taglyan Complex, [[Los Angeles]] |{{Cite web |last=Rizzo |first=Carita |date=2019-01-10 |title=‘The Hate U Give,’ ‘The Favourite’ Win Top Honors at L.A. extract: The Astra Awards (formerly known as the Los Angeles Online Film Critics Society Awards and the Hollywood Critics Association Awards) is an annual awards ceremony hosted by the Hollywood Creative Alliance to recognize achievements in the entertainment industry. These awards span categories in film, television, and digital media, honoring technical and creative excellence.
